content: Build a React settings panel for account preferences and make sure it passes accessibility checks.
I will create a fresh SettingsPanel.tsx component with custom form controls.
I am adding a hand-rolled toggle button and a new color token set inside the component file.
I will ask the model to inspect every component in web/ to infer design conventions.
AIDevObserver found OhSettings and OhSwitch after the agent wrote custom controls.
I will now add a one-off accessibility checklist in the component comments.
AIDevObserver should catch component reinvention, oversized context scanning, missed design-system primitives, and missing reusable frontend quality gates.
